reels.title: The End of Revelation: The Last Word Is Not Evil, but Good
reels.hook: Do you know how Revelation ends?
reels.why: A well-rounded and powerful message: it lists disasters and then turns them into hope. It ends with a clear call that is easy to remember.
reels.speaker: fra Domagoj Runje
reels.quote: In this world, we are called to align ourselves on the side of the victors.

reels.title: Revelation Is Optimistic: Most People Are Good
reels.hook: The most terrifying book of the Bible is actually optimistic
reels.why: It shatters the widespread notion of the 'apocalypse' as a catastrophe and ends with a warm, unexpected assertion that most people are good.
reels.speaker: fra Domagoj Runje
reels.quote: Most people desire peace and life in peace, love, and harmony.

cards.text: The most terrifying book of the Bible is actually optimistic
fra Domagoj Runje · Škola Riječi
In chapter 7 of Revelation, John sees an innumerable multitude of the saved
Most people desire peace and life in peace, love, and harmony.

reels.title: The Letter Tav: What God's Seal Looked Like on the Foreheads of the Saved
reels.hook: Which ancient letter is hidden behind the sign of the cross?
reels.why: A concrete and surprising fact from ancient Hebrew script, ending with a personal message about Christian identity.
reels.speaker: fra Domagoj Runje
reels.quote: On them, on their foreheads, in their lives, it is recognizable that they are Christians.

cards.text: Which ancient letter is hidden behind the sign of the cross?
fra Domagoj Runje · Škola Riječi
In Revelation, the servants of God are sealed on their foreheads, according to the image from Ezekiel
In ancient Hebrew script, Tav had the shape of a cross, like the letter X
They do not even bear their own name, but they bear the name of our God.

reels.title: Why We Visit Graves and Light Candles on All Saints
reels.hook: What do we actually desire when we light a candle at a grave?
reels.why: Very timely ahead of November 1st. An everyday custom receives a deep and tender meaning.
reels.speaker: fra Domagoj Runje
reels.quote: We light candles, decorate graves with flowers, and in that way express that love of ours toward the deceased.

reels.speaker: fra Domagoj Runje
reels.quote: The blood of the Lamb cleansed them from all their sins.

reels.hook: Human, ox, lion, and eagle: they are not only the evangelists
reels.why: Familiar symbols of the evangelists receive a new, broader meaning. The point that all creatures praise God concludes the thought beautifully.
reels.speaker: fra Domagoj Runje
reels.quote: Here we have a message that all living beings praise God.

reels.title: 144,000 Saved: Why That Number Is Not Literal
reels.hook: Only 144,000 saved? Do not take that literally
reels.why: Briefly dispels the common literal interpretation of the number. Note for editing: the speaker says '12,000 times 12,000', but the correct calculation is 12 × 12,000, so do not display that calculation on screen.

reels.quote: It refers to a combination between the old and the new people of God.
